claims: Five separate agents running simultaneously, each for at least 20 minutes unattended after 'complex planning'
One agent reads 18 repos and 3 live websites to plan a rebuild of the corporate site for investors with an easy pitch deck
Claude built a desktop app (no hosting) to sync every Google calendar into Apple Calendar
Cursor is building a before/after gallery management tool to release to clients
Cowork is producing marketing plans and pricing structure in real time
how_to_steps: Do detailed planning with each agent first
Launch separate agent sessions per project on separate screens/windows
Let them run autonomously 20+ minutes; check in across machines
Use Cowork (browser access) for non-code work like marketing and pricing in parallel
on_screen_only: Caption 'Building 5 projects at the same time with Claude' on every frame
Dark bedroom with several laptops/monitors showing Claude Code terminal diffs and a Cursor chat; a landing page titled 'Before & After Gallery Management'
Stack of Miller Lite cans and a Gatorade Zero on the desk
